# Overview

## Row {height="30%"}

### Project Introduction

**Dataset:** All Candidate Neighborhoods for Connection-Based Revitalization

**Link:** https://opportunityinsights.org/data/

**High-Level Questions:** 

1. Where are the largest opportunity gaps, and how are they distributed geographically?

2. How do opportunity outcomes relate to neighborhood demographics and conditions?

3. How have population percentages and monetary statistics changed from 2010 to 2020 and where are those changes most significant? 

4. What are the common metrics between neighborhoods that were selected for project funding and obtained a positive upward mobility score? 


## Row {height="70%"}

### Geographic Distribution of Opportunity Gaps

# Opportunity Gaps

### Goals
**One:** Do large-gap tracts cluster in certain metros or neighborhoods?

## Row

### Plot
```{python}
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

CSV = "HOPEVI_All_Candidate_Neighborhoods.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(CSV, thousands=",", dtype={"tract_code_2010": str, "tract_code_2020": str})

#
def clean(s):
    return pd.to_numeric(s.astype(str).str.replace(r"[$,%]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")

for c in df.columns:
    if c.startswith(("share_", "poverty_rate_", "median_household_income_", "median_rent_")):
        df[c] = clean(df[c])
for c in ["upward_mobility", "adult_income_nearest_10_tracts", "opportunity_gap",
          "pop_density_2020", "land_area"]:
    df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

df["upward_mobility"] *= 100  

# Metro-relative gapg
df = df.dropna(subset=["lat", "lon", "msa_name", "upward_mobility"])
df = df[df["flag_in_top_100_msas"] == 1].copy()
g = df.groupby("msa_name")["upward_mobility"]
df["metro_median"] = g.transform("median")
df["metro_gap"] = df["upward_mobility"] - df["metro_median"]    
df["large_gap"] = g.rank(pct=True) <= 0.10                      
df["label"] = df["neighborhood"].fillna(df["city"])

# Demo subset: every tract in a few metros (big -> small)
demo_msas = df["msa_name"].value_counts().index[[0, 5, 20, 50]]
map_df = df[df["msa_name"].isin(demo_msas)].copy()
```

```{python}
fig1 = go.Figure()
msas = list(demo_msas)

for i, m in enumerate(msas):
    d = map_df[map_df["msa_name"] == m]
    fig1.add_trace(go.Scattermap(
        lat=d["lat"], lon=d["lon"], mode="markers", name=m, visible=(i == 0),
        marker=dict(
            size=np.where(d["large_gap"], 11, 7),
            color=d["metro_gap"], colorscale="RdBu", cmid=0, cmin=-25, cmax=25,
            colorbar=dict(title="Gap vs. metro<br>median (pctl pts)"),
            opacity=0.85,
        ),
        customdata=np.stack([d["label"].fillna(""), d["city"].fillna(""),
                             d["upward_mobility"], d["metro_median"],
                             d["poverty_rate_2020"]], axis=-1),
        hovertemplate=("<b>%{customdata[0]}</b> (%{customdata[1]})<br>"
                       "Upward mobility: %{customdata[2]:.1f}<br>"
                       "Metro median: %{customdata[3]:.1f}<br>"
                       "Poverty rate: %{customdata[4]:.0f}%<extra></extra>"),
    ))

# Dropdown: one button per metro, with the map re-centered on it
buttons = []
for i, m in enumerate(msas):
    d = map_df[map_df["msa_name"] == m]
    buttons.append(dict(
        label=m.split(",")[0].split("-")[0], method="update",
        args=[{"visible": [j == i for j in range(len(msas))]},
              {"map.center": {"lat": d["lat"].mean(), "lon": d["lon"].mean()},
               "map.zoom": 8.5 if len(d) > 2000 else 9.5}]))

fig1.update_layout(
    map=dict(style="carto-positron",
             center=dict(lat=map_df[map_df.msa_name == msas[0]]["lat"].mean(),
                         lon=map_df[map_df.msa_name == msas[0]]["lon"].mean()),
             zoom=8.5),
    updatemenus=[dict(buttons=buttons, direction="down", x=0.01, y=0.99,
                      xanchor="left", yanchor="top")],
    title="Gaps in upward mobility (red = largest gaps)",
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=50, b=0), height=600, showlegend=False,
)
fig1.show()

```


```{python}
TOP_N = 15

fig3 = go.Figure()

for i, m in enumerate(msas):
    d = (map_df[map_df["msa_name"] == m]
         .nsmallest(TOP_N, "metro_gap")                 # most negative = largest gap
         .sort_values("metro_gap", ascending=False))    # so the largest gap plots on top
    # Unique, readable y labels: neighborhood (city) + tract id suffix
    ylab = (d["label"].fillna("Unnamed") + " (" + d["city"].fillna("") + ") · "
            + d["tract_code_2010"].str[-6:])
    fig3.add_trace(go.Bar(
        x=d["metro_gap"], y=ylab, orientation="h", visible=(i == 0), name=m,
        marker=dict(color=d["metro_gap"], colorscale="RdBu", cmid=0, cmin=-25, cmax=25),
        customdata=np.stack([d["upward_mobility"], d["metro_median"],
                             d["poverty_rate_2020"], d["median_household_income_2020"]], axis=-1),
        hovertemplate=("<b>%{y}</b><br>Gap vs. metro median: %{x:.1f} pctl pts<br>"
                       "Upward mobility: %{customdata[0]:.1f}<br>"
                       "Metro median: %{customdata[1]:.1f}<br>"
                       "Poverty rate: %{customdata[2]:.0f}%<br>"
                       "Median HH income: $%{customdata[3]:,.0f}<extra></extra>"),
    ))

buttons = [dict(label=m.split(",")[0].split("-")[0], method="update",
                args=[{"visible": [j == i for j in range(len(msas))]}])
           for i, m in enumerate(msas)]

fig3.update_layout(
    title=f"The {TOP_N} tracts furthest below their metro's median upward mobility",
    updatemenus=[dict(buttons=buttons, direction="down", x=0.01, y=1.12,
                      xanchor="left", yanchor="top")],
    xaxis=dict(title="Gap vs. metro median (percentile points)", zeroline=True,
               zerolinewidth=2),
    yaxis=dict(title=None, automargin=True),
    margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=90, b=40), height=600, showlegend=False,
)
fig3.show()
```



# Outcomes
**Two:** How do outcomes relate to neighborhood demographics and conditions?

## Row

### Plot

```{python}
s = map_df.dropna(subset=["poverty_rate_2020", "upward_mobility",
                          "median_household_income_2020"]).copy()

# Fitted line and residuals (no statsmodels needed)
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(s["poverty_rate_2020"], s["upward_mobility"], 1)
s["fitted"] = intercept + slope * s["poverty_rate_2020"]
s["resid"] = s["upward_mobility"] - s["fitted"]
outliers = s.loc[s["resid"].abs().nlargest(8).index]

fig2 = px.scatter(
    s, x="poverty_rate_2020", y="upward_mobility",
    color="median_household_income_2020", color_continuous_scale="Viridis",
    facet_col="msa_name", facet_col_wrap=2, opacity=0.6,
    hover_name="label",
    hover_data={"city": True, "poverty_rate_2020": ":.0f", "upward_mobility": ":.1f",
                "median_household_income_2020": ":$,.0f", "msa_name": False},
    labels={"poverty_rate_2020": "Poverty rate (%)",
            "upward_mobility": "Upward mobility (income rank, pctl)",
            "median_household_income_2020": "Median HH income"},
    title="Poverty rate and upward mobility by metro",
    height=650,
)

# Overall trend line (dashed) on every facet
xs = np.array([s["poverty_rate_2020"].min(), s["poverty_rate_2020"].max()])
fig2.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=xs, y=intercept + slope * xs, mode="lines",
                          line=dict(color="black", dash="dash"),
                          name="Overall fit", hoverinfo="skip"),
               row="all", col="all")

# Label the biggest outliers
fig2.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=outliers["poverty_rate_2020"], y=outliers["upward_mobility"],
    mode="markers+text", text=outliers["label"], textposition="top center",
    marker=dict(size=11, color="rgba(0,0,0,0)", line=dict(color="red", width=2)),
    name="Outliers (largest residuals)", hoverinfo="skip"))

fig2.for_each_annotation(lambda a: a.update(text=a.text.split("=")[-1].split(",")[0]))
fig2.show()
```

### Plot

```{python}
s = map_df.dropna(subset=["share_black_2020", "metro_gap"]).copy()

# Fit line and residuals
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(s["share_black_2020"], s["metro_gap"], 1)
s["resid"] = s["metro_gap"] - (intercept + slope * s["share_black_2020"])
outliers = s.loc[s["resid"].abs().nlargest(10).index]

fig5 = px.scatter(
    s, x="share_black_2020", y="metro_gap", color="msa_name", opacity=0.55,
    hover_name="label",
    hover_data={"city": True, "share_black_2020": ":.0f", "metro_gap": ":.1f",
                "poverty_rate_2020": ":.0f", "msa_name": False},
    labels={"share_black_2020": "Share Black (%)",
            "metro_gap": "Gap vs. metro median upward mobility (pctl pts)",
            "msa_name": "Metro", "poverty_rate_2020": "Poverty rate (%)"},
    title="Black population share and distance from metro median",
    height=600,
)

# Fit line
xs = np.array([0, 100])
fig5.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=xs, y=intercept + slope * xs, mode="lines",
                          line=dict(color="black", dash="dash"),
                          name="Overall fit", hoverinfo="skip"))

# Outlined, labeled outliers
fig5.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=outliers["share_black_2020"], y=outliers["metro_gap"],
    mode="markers+text", text=outliers["label"], textposition="top center",
    marker=dict(symbol="circle-open", size=18, line=dict(color="red", width=2.5)),
    name="Largest outliers", hovertext=outliers["label"], hoverinfo="text"))

fig5.show()
```
